videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Lior and Rotem drive to Issyk-Kul, the biggest lake in Kyrgyzstan, where they meet the locals and discuss their different experiences of fame.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The pair navigates a treacherous mountain road to reach a hot spring. A visit to a livestock farm shows Lior the life he always thought he'd have.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: As they arrive in the city of Karakol, Rotem challenges Lior to his most stressful experience so far: a manicure, followed by getting tattoos.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Lior and Rotem drive on to the remote village of Jyrgalang, where a session with a shaman tells them how they were connected in a previous life.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Crossing the border into Kazakhstan, Lior and Rotem reflect on their arduous journey and what it taught them about themselves and each other.
